decisions.reason: As a low-cost dental consumable with strong fit to the firm's core laboratory workflow portfolio, it is likely to stay in the range if it has remained marketable this long.
This thermoforming blank sits very close to the firm's established materials business, so after several years it would usually be retained as a standard portfolio item rather than exited.

Because it was only weakly signaled from the start and is an ancillary accessory, the option value is largely exhausted by 2022 and management would likely prune it to free attention for stronger lines and new development.
Its link to digital and clinical workflows still supports keeping it, although changing application preferences make it somewhat more exposed than the core materials products.
